paragraphs: $5-S10NL: Hero raises to $30. The Big Blind calls. Don't worry about getting check-raised off a draw. That happens sd infrequently that it shouldn't even be a part of your thought process. Very few players actively seek to check-raise turns. As a result, you can follow through on the turn with impunity.
